items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Sidney Bourgeois used to come into Pop Toros... Well, me and I used to hang out there.

ctx.x: My teacher was working that night, I had a music teacher who worked on Franklin Street. They called him Hoss, I don't know if you remember him, he's from across the river. Fess they called him, you know, Professor Mineta. Oh yes, yes. Yeah, and he and Peter Bocards were telling me about it.

Well, I'll tell you about Sidney Bourgeois, you read about the killing and all like that? Mm-hmm. Sidney Bourgeois used to come into Pop Toros, that's based on Bambler Street, where the piano players, well there's only a few of them, one played for Lilla White and one for Josie Arlington. Of course, Tony Jackson never come in there, see. Well, me and I used to hang out there. Pop Toros used to use us quite often, see. He got a dollar and I got two dollars a night, see. So I used to walk a meal home. He lived off…
Did you tell him who? I'm telling the truth. Did you tell him who Sidney Bourgeois is? Who, if he knew who Sidney Bourgeois was?
